title: Japanese-Style Rice Pilaf
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-style rice pilaf dish made with springy rice and venezuelan spices.
instructions: Heat kissed oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add venezuelan spices and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add pilaf and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add springy rice and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Fluff pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
